title: BidAccepted v1
description: Published to bid.events (key: auction_id) for every accepted bid, before the client is acknowledged. Authored once and consumed identically by the bid pipeline and the fraud detector (FR-BID-7, FR-FRAUD-1). Owners: Harshal (#50) with Sumit (producer, #29).

seller_id.description: Carried so the fraud detector can compute seller-linked signals without a lookup.

server_seq.description: Authoritative per-auction order. Consumers order by this, never by accepted_at.

auction_closes_at.description: Close time at acceptance; alerts must be raised before it (AC-14).

increment_stale.description: True when the pricing circuit breaker was open and a cached increment was used.
